messages:
maya: Quick sync — customer-req: they want explicit rollback criteria when we change retention defaults + a 30-day opt-in for BYO-KMS before contract kicks in. Can we map this to clear SLA language and a runbook?

alex.k: TL;DR: we can expose a "rollback window" and a pre-change notification period. proposal: 30d notice for retention config, 7d rollback window post-change. translate to SLA: time-to-restore/data-access, not a hard deletion revert.

jamal: security note: legal holds override retention deletions. if legal_hold exists, rollback should not unfreeze data — need explicit legal clearance. also BYOK key revocation timelines affect ability to export.

sophie: customers also asked for proof-of-deletion + export package for their audits. we should standardize export format (JSONL + sha256 manifests) and include signed deletion receipts.

erin: @maya good call. legal prefers clause language: "Retention changes require X-day notice; customer may request rollback within Y days; rollback limited to non-legal-hold records; proofs provided as signed manifests." i'll draft a suggestion.

alex.k: sample SLA snippet for engineering review: 
```
Retention Change SLA:
- Notification: 30 days before production change.
- Rollback window: 7 days after change; rollback applies to non-legal-hold records only.
- Proof: Export bundle (JSONL) + signed manifest (sha256) delivered within 72 hours of request.
- Failure mode: If rollback fails, operator will provide remediation plan and target timeline; credits per contract.
```

maya: love it. open questions: what constitutes a failure (partial deletes, missing keys), and how do we quantify credits?

jamal: define failure = inability to return data to pre-change accessible state for >= 24h after initiating rollback, or proof not verifiable. BYOK-specific failure case = key unavailable for export.

erin: legal will accept credits tied to downtime windows. propose table: 0-24h = 0% credits, 24-72h = 5% monthly fee, >72h = escalated remedies. i'll draft formal wording.

ops-bot: runbook updated: retention-rollback-playbook v1.2 published — https://confluence.internal/retention-rollback (editable by eng/ops).

sophie: owner requests: eng to confirm feasibility of 7d rollback for 1TB/tenant, and ops to estimate manual steps for BYOK exports.

alex.k: quick feasibility note: automated prefix-cache + snapshot-based rollback is possible for recent windows; full rehydration for >30d will need cold restore — not guaranteed within 7d for very large tenants. we should surface size-based exceptions in SLA.

maya: OK — action items:
- alex.k: feasibility doc + size-exceptions matrix by EOD Thu.
- jamal: legal-hold integration checklist by Tue.
- erin: draft contract language + credits table by Tue.
- sophie: sample export spec + proof-of-deletion template by Tue.

maya: I'll collate and schedule a short stakeholder review Fri 10am. @ops-bot please ping #product on publish. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: Fri 10:00 — agenda: SLA wording, size exceptions, BYOK opt-in timeline.
